notes:
Patch 0.1.12

This is a full Windows build. Get it from the website Download button. The game will not quit itself to install this.

Multiplayer
- Other players can see the item you have selected in hand.
- Host and clients share the same time of day and day of year.
- Remote player walk and run clips play through instead of freezing on the first frame.
- Rune sprites walk and idle on clients.
- Ride bug lift height matches the host, and sits about three feet higher.
- Hold INS to see who is on the current server.
- Chat typing no longer steals move and look. Group and Friends buttons no longer overlap.

World
- Clear weather fog sits at about two thirds the old distance.
- Leaves sit in the fog instead of on top of it.
- Walking backward plays walk and run in reverse.
- Nightlings detect farther and are slightly smaller.
- Trolls pick a new clear walk when blocked.
- Crocodiles no longer float high off the ground.

Sealclash
- The table AI takes downs first when a Front is soft enough.
- Pip economy is slower.

UI
- Settings live on the pause menu, including the screen border control.

Still from 0.1.11
- Daytime animals at half density. Dense foliage. Scarcer ore. Far creatures sleep their scripts. Underwater tint only when wet. Cheaper fog and clouds.
